package stats

// Summary counts rows and tracks how many accounts were seen.
type Summary struct {
	count        int
	accountCount int
}

func (s *Summary) Add(account string) {
	s.count++
	if account != "" {
		s.accountCount++
	}
}

func (s *Summary) Rows() int     { return s.count }
func (s *Summary) Accounts() int { return s.accountCount }
